QuestInfo.name: Asking After Pia, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to check on #b#p218##k, a resident of the town. Let's go see how #p218# is doing.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p218#, a resident of #m10001000#. I'm glad to see she's doing well!

0.0: "I'm curious to know how #p218#, one of #m10001000#'s residents, is doing lately. It would be wonderful if you could check on her for me.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Oh, you're #h0#, aren't you? What brings you by today? If you came here because you want to hang out with me, could you wait just a little bit? Right now, I'm waiting to see when an Orange Mushroom is going to pop out of that clock tower over there.
1.1: I could stare at that clock tower all day long and never get bored of it. Hey, why don't you come sit right next to me and watch the clock tower together? It's gonna be so much fun!

level.0: But you... your level is, like, way too low?
